name: grit-taskboard
description: Grit Taskboard — ops kanban PWA with event-driven card automation. api/ holds the small set of Vercel serverless functions backing auth and the ops-tasks sync (plus the cross-app grit-events webhook); the app itself has no build step. Deliberately left without "type": "module" — Node's native require(esm) interop already loads the ESM `export default` syntax in api/*.js and lib/*.js fine without that flag.
